templates.name: Printed Retail Bag Line
templates.tagline: Resin in, branded bags out — full-colour printing built into the line.
templates.bestFor: Brands and retailers who need their logo, colours, or barcode printed directly on the bag.
whyBest: 6-colour flexo printing at 260 m/min keeps branding in-house instead of outsourcing to a print shop.
±0.1 mm registration means small text and fine barcodes stay sharp at full production speed.
Closed-loop pelletizing recovers edge trim and reject film back into resin, cutting material waste across the whole line.
One continuous line from film to finished bag — fewer handoffs, less work-in-progress sitting between machines.

steps.role: Resin is melted and blown into a 5-layer co-extruded film, 2,100 mm wide.
The film is printed in up to 6 colours at 260 m/min with ±0.1 mm registration.
Printed film is heat-sealed and cut into finished bags across multiple lanes.
Edge trim and reject bags are pelletized back into resin and fed to step one.

templates.name: Roll Bag / Grocery Line
templates.tagline: A simpler, lower-cost line for plain retail and grocery roll bags.
templates.bestFor: Grocery, produce, and retail roll bags where speed and cost matter more than printed branding.
whyBest: No printing stage — lower equipment cost and simpler operation than a full printed line.
Inline perforation and automatic core-cutting produce retail-ready rolls with no manual finishing.
Fewer machines means a smaller footprint and faster line commissioning on-site.
The same closed-loop pelletizing recovers scrap film into resin, so the line still keeps material waste down.

steps.role: Resin is melted and blown into a 5-layer co-extruded film, 2,100 mm wide.
Film is perforated and wound onto rolls with automatic core-cutting for retail-ready packs.
Edge trim and scrap film are pelletized back into resin and fed to step one.
